column1: # Wave verification in Xcode Cloud (chapter 09): one row per required execution of the candidate
# <CANDIDATE_SHA> on branch wave/approved-20260930T173856Z. Authorized by the founder on 30 September 2026:
# one build of a manual Wave Verification workflow, at most 160 compute minutes across its two actions, no
# automatic retry, no archive and no TestFlight distribution. Nothing below has run on an Apple system yet. Runbook: docs/verification/wave-xcode-cloud-verification.md. The Room
# and Places rows keep the IDs and methods of docs/verification/room-xcode-cloud-manifest.tsv; the Wave rows
# Columns (tab-separated): row, plan, destination, test, proves, prior, last_seconds, required.
#   plan          TestPlans/<plan>.xctestplan; D2 is not in Xcode Cloud (see its row).
#   destination   the simulator the plan's Test action must run on: iPhone 17 Pro Max (440 x 956), or
#                 iPhone 17e (390 x 844), else iPhone 16e (also 390 x 844), recorded.
#   prior         the last result. Room Verification on the base 1a5f97e (App Store Connect build 29af42f6):
#                 both actions succeeded with 0 test failures, but GitHub shows no per-test result or count.
#   last_seconds  the last measured test duration on Codemagic (Mac mini M2, iOS 26.5), as in the Room
#                 manifest; for the Wave rows, which never ran, an estimate. Xcode Cloud per-test times are
#   required      yes for every row: the Wave changed RoomDemo.swift, RoomView.swift, DemoSession.swift and
#                 DebugFixtures.swift, added WaveDemo.swift and WaveView.swift, and changed the Room tests'
#                 shared helpers, so no earlier result carries over. The founder's decisions of 30 September
#                 2026 (the menu's visible Back, the disabled starts after a block, "you" by identity, the
#                 queued Block's actor and run) changed them again, and added the run's compute guard
#                 (RunBudget.swift) to every UI test class these plans select.
# Chosen: every Wave test; every Room test; every Places test that goes into the Room (P4 and P9 added to
# P1, C1, C15, C12 and C11 for that reason). Left out, never opening the Room: C2, C3, P2, C9, C4-C8 (440 pt)
# and P10-P13, C10, C13, C14 (390 pt); see the runbook section 2.
# Pass: every row executed once and passed at <CANDIDATE_SHA>. Skipped, not run, repeated or retried is not a
# pass, and a test the compute guard stopped (RUN_BUDGET_SPENT in the log) is a failure of the run, not of the
# product. Counts: Main 30 UI + 250 domain = 280, Small 7, so 287 native executions; the 8 D2 tests run once,
# on the VPS, and are not among the 250 (the domain target has 258).
